headline: NHPC Limited: Government of India files Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure
sum: Government of India, via Ministry of Power, filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Regulations with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition in NHPC Limited. The specific shareholding threshold crossed, acquisition price and structure remain detailed in the filed disclosure.
detail: NHPC Limited, a central public sector undertaking (CPSU) under the Ministry of Power, received a Regulation 31(4) disclosure from the Government of India. Such disclosures are mandatory under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, when an acquirer crosses prescribed threshold limits (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, etc. of paid-up capital). The specific shareholding movement, valuation and any conditional mechanics are contained in the filed disclosure document.
